prompt:
Precise LOCAL GOURD DESIGN/MATERIAL enhancement. IMAGE1 is the healer artwork to edit. IMAGE2 is the project's HEALING GEM design reference. Replace the currently plain brown medicinal gourd with a more distinctive HEALING-JADE AND GEMSTONE GOURD inspired directly by image2.

Keep the gourd's CURRENT large size, two-bellied silhouette, position and diagonal tilt, with neck/stopper pointing UPPER RIGHT and large belly cradled on her SINGLE supporting forearm. Preserve the hand contact and relaxed free hand. Do not change the healer at all.

GOURD REDESIGN:
Use the healing gem's saturated yellow-green / jade-green broad facets and rounded double-belly form as the main body. The gourd should now feel carved from luminous HEALING JADE, with honey-yellow/chartreuse upper light faces and deep jade/emerald side planes, low to moderate polish and a few strong broad plane transitions. About 4–5 big faces over the main belly, 3 big faces over the small bulb, NOT dozens of tiny triangles.
Retain one simple medicinal LEAF identity on the big belly, but transform the old painted flat leaf into ONE broad pale-celadon leaf-shaped stone INLAY, slightly inset and smoothly integrated. Add only a tiny pale honey-gold rim around this inset if useful. This is the secondary gemstone material; main body remains green healing jade. No scattered jewel studs.
Waist tie is still a simple dark-green cord with a single small dull-gold fastening, no complex tassels or chains. Stopper should be a small warm amber/honey-stone cap with a simple dull-gold collar, giving material contrast. Keep it clearly a usable medicinal vessel rather than an abstract gem sculpture. No metal cage around the whole gourd.
Light/dark separation must keep the jade gourd distinguishable from the green hair/shoulder: belly has lighter chartreuse front planes, rich darker green edge and pale leaf inset. Use simplified project icon rendering with thick dark outline and controlled broad facet highlights, no photoreal glass, transparent bottle view, neon glow, sparkles, realistic reflection environment or visual noise.
Do NOT add more gems to the character's clothes or hair. Her exact green sprout hairstyle, face, head/body proportions, outfit, pose, hands, leaf motifs, shoes, sachet, framing and warm ivory background remain as in image1. One full-body square result only, no labels, extras or collage.
purpose: Enhance the gourd with project healing-gem jade facets, pale celadon leaf inset and warm amber cap, preserving its hold and tilt.
visual_review: Gourd now uses healing-gem yellow-green/jade facets, a pale leaf-shaped inset and warm amber-gold cap; diagonal single-arm hold retained.
